CODE 
Art. 2.3.71. 
Valuation of the participation claim 
If the marriage is dissolved by divorce or if the matrimonial property regime is dissolved by another judicial decision, the participation claim is determined on the basis of the composition and value of the assets of the spouses on the date on which the legal action is brought.
